question.prompt: Which of the following values cannot be the probability of an event: 0.3, 1.2, −0.1, 1, 0? (Write all values that are impossible, separated by commas.)

solutions.explanation: Probability satisfies \(0\le P\le1\). Since 1.2 is greater than 1 and −0.1 is less than 0, these 2 numbers cannot be probabilities.
solutions.title: Apply the probability range
